run_eval_runner: run the eval_runner function to evaluate a model's bounding box predictions against ground truth on a dataset
build_instance_model: build a subclass of InstanceModel that implements step_traj and get_instances_for_query methods
test_eval_runner: test the eval_runner function with a mock InstanceModel and dataset to verify bounding box evaluation
review_instance_model: review the InstanceModel abstract class and its step_traj and get_instances_for_query interface methods
summarize_eval_runner: summarize the eval_runner function that evaluates model bounding box predictions using hydra_zen configuration
